id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying an instance url that answers not found

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and user experience for Matomo connector
review.reason: Adds a non-retryable classification for 404 Client Errors in warehouse ingestion, preventing repeated scheduling of failed Matomo ingestion jobs and providing actionable user guidance. P1.F1.H1 introduces the error entry and P1.F2.H1 adds the corresponding test. This demonstrates a bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of a retry-avoidance and user-message addition. The actual production benefit, such as reduced support tickets or successful ingestion recovery, is not independently verified and relies on the implementation being deployed and effective.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
